title: What is the future of work?

vocabulary.meaning: the use of technology to perform tasks with limited human involvement
examples: The article gave a clear example of automation.
We discussed automation during the session.

vocabulary.meaning: work carried out away from a traditional office, often from home
examples: Many people have strong opinions about remote work.
Understanding remote work helped me follow the discussion.

vocabulary.meaning: learning new abilities in order to do a different type of job
examples: Reskilling was one of the key ideas in the article.
I used the term reskilling when explaining my opinion.

vocabulary.meaning: a labour market based on short-term, freelance, or task-based work
examples: The speaker described how gig economy can affect people's lives.
Our group talked about the advantages and disadvantages of gig economy.

vocabulary.meaning: the likelihood that a person will be able to keep their job
examples: The discussion made me think more carefully about job security.
Different countries may have different experiences with job security.

vocabulary.meaning: a work arrangement combining remote work with time in a workplace
examples: I had heard of hybrid work before, but I did not fully understand it.
After the lesson, I could explain hybrid work in my own words.
